en.t: That is right near our magazine office.

units.source_text: 女人出生在甲州，二十八歲，與五歲的女兒一起住在高円寺的公寓裡。

en.t: The woman had been born in Koshu, was twenty eight years old, and lived in an apartment in Koenji with her five year old daughter.

units.source_text: 聽她說丈夫已經去世三年了。

en.t: She told me that her husband had died three years earlier.

units.source_text: 「你看起來像是吃苦長大的人。

en.t: You look like someone who grew up knowing a great deal of hardship.

units.source_text: 難怪這麼善解人意，真夠可憐的。」

en.t: No wonder you are so considerate. Poor thing.

units.source_text: 從此我開始了被豢養的小白臉的生活。

en.t: From then on, I began living as a kept man.

units.source_text: 靜子（這是那名女記者的名字）去新宿的雜誌社上班時，我就和她叫茂子的五歲女兒一起看家。

en.t: When Shizuko, which was the woman reporter's name, went to work at the magazine office in Shinjuku, I stayed home with her five year old daughter, Shigeko.

units.source_text: 在此之前，靜子外出時，茂子總是在公寓管理員的房間玩耍，

en.t: Before that, whenever Shizuko went out, Shigeko would always play in the apartment manager's room,

units.source_text: 現在來了一位「善解人意」的叔叔陪她玩，她看起來很開心。

en.t: but now that a considerate uncle had appeared to play with her, she seemed very happy.

units.source_text: 我稀裡糊塗地在她那兒待了一星期左右。

en.t: I drifted along there for about a week without really thinking.
